questions.question: Which is the largest species of penguin in the world?
questions.hint: Emperor Penguins can grow over 1.2 meters (4 feet) tall and survive the harsh Antarctic winter.

questions.question: Which animal has the longest migration of any mammal?
questions.hint: Gray whales migrate up to 20,000 kilometers (12,400 miles) annually between Arctic feeding grounds and Mexican breeding lagoons.

questions.question: Which director won the Academy Award for Best Director for the film The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King?
questions.hint: Peter Jackson's epic conclusion swept the Oscars, winning all 11 awards for which it was nominated.

questions.question: In Star Wars, what is the home planet of Luke Skywalker?
questions.hint: Luke Skywalker grew up on the desert planet Tatooine with his aunt and uncle.

questions.question: Which international organization designates World Heritage Sites?
questions.hint: UNESCO recognizes sites of outstanding cultural and natural importance around the world.

questions.question: Which document protects fundamental rights and freedoms in the European Union?
options: Charter of Fundamental Rights of the European Union
questions.hint: The Charter became legally binding in 2009 and guarantees a wide range of civil, political, and social rights within the EU.

questions.question: Which civilization built the famous city of Petra?
questions.hint: Petra, carved into rose-colored sandstone cliffs in present-day Jordan, was the capital of the Nabataean Kingdom.

questions.question: Which Chinese dynasty is credited with building much of the present-day Great Wall of China?
questions.hint: Although earlier walls existed, most of the Great Wall seen today was constructed during the Ming Dynasty.

questions.question: Which country has won the most Rugby World Cup titles (men's tournament)?
questions.hint: South Africa became the first nation to win four Rugby World Cup titles after its 2023 victory.

questions.question: In Formula One, what color flag signals the immediate stoppage of a race?
questions.hint: A red flag is displayed when conditions are too dangerous for the race to continue safely.

questions.question: Which country is home to the world's highest uninterrupted waterfall, Angel Falls?
questions.hint: Angel Falls drops 979 meters (3,212 feet) from Auyán-tepui in Venezuela.

questions.question: Which is the largest country in Africa by land area?
questions.hint: Algeria covers more than 2.38 million square kilometers, making it Africa's largest country.

questions.question: Which scientist discovered penicillin in 1928?
questions.hint: Fleming observed that a mold inhibited bacterial growth, leading to the discovery of penicillin.

questions.question: Which part of the human brain is primarily responsible for balance and coordination?
questions.hint: The cerebellum fine-tunes movement, posture, and balance.

questions.question: Which country is credited with inventing paper?
questions.hint: Paper was developed in ancient China, traditionally credited to Cai Lun during the Han Dynasty.

questions.question: Which musical instrument is traditionally associated with Scotland?
questions.hint: The Great Highland bagpipe is one of Scotland's most recognizable national symbols.

questions.question: Which mammal has the longest gestation period?
questions.hint: African elephants are pregnant for about 22 months, the longest known gestation among mammals.

questions.question: Which sea lies between Europe and Africa?
questions.hint: The Mediterranean Sea has connected civilizations in Europe, Africa, and Asia for thousands of years.

questions.question: Which branch of physics studies heat and energy transfer?
questions.hint: Thermodynamics examines the relationships between heat, work, energy, and temperature.

questions.question: Which civilization first developed a widespread alphabet that influenced many modern writing systems?
questions.hint: The Phoenician alphabet became the basis for Greek, Latin, and many other writing systems.
